info.name: QuitQ Ecommerce APIs
info.description:
Collection for the QuitQ E-Commerce Spring Boot backend running at http://localhost:8080 (MySQL db quitq_db).

Organised one folder per application flow:
- Flow 1 - Auth & Signup: login, customer/seller signup and user management
- Flow 2/6/8 - Category & Product: category CRUD, product catalogue, search, filter, stock
- Flow 3/4 - Address & Cart: shipping addresses and the shopping cart
- Flow 4/5/7/8 - Order, Payment, Seller & Admin: order lifecycle, payments, seller order items, admin analytics

Seeded data: customers 1 (john_doe / john@123) and 2 (jane / jane@123); sellers 1 (techstore) and 2 (fashionhub); categories 1 Electronics, 2 Mobile, 3 Fashion, 4 Home & Furniture; products 1 Sony WH-1000XM5, 2 Dell XPS 15, 3 iPhone 15 Pro, 4 Cotton Shirt, 5 Office Chair; customer 1 has shipping address 1 and order 1 (Q1791738744814, UPI, COMPLETED).

There is no authentication token: every endpoint is open and accepts JSON directly.

item.name: Flow 1 - Auth & Signup
item.description: Authentication plus customer, seller and user registration and management.

item.name: Login - customer john_doe
item.description: Authenticates a user with the LoginDto body (username, password). Returns the matching user profile with its role. No token is issued, so no further requests need to carry credentials. Expected: 200 with the user JSON, or 400 for an unknown username.

item.name: Signup customer
item.description: Registers a new customer with the SignupDto body (name, gender, contactNumber, username, email, password). gender is optional; every other field is required. Returns the created customer with its generated id. Clean up test signups with DELETE /api/customer/{id}.

item.name: Signup customer - ERROR duplicate username
item.description: Error scenario: signs up with the already-registered username john_doe. Expected: 400 with message "Username already taken".

item.name: Signup customer - ERROR empty required fields
item.description: Error scenario: sends an empty body for every required field. Expected: 400 with one validation message per field ("Name is required", "Contact number is required", "Username is required", "Email is required", "Password is required").

item.name: Get all customers
item.description: Returns every registered customer with ids, usernames and contact details.

item.name: Get customer by id
item.description: Returns the customer with id 1 (john_doe). Expected: 200, or 400 for an unknown id.

item.name: Delete customer by id
item.description: Deletes the customer row with the given id (use the id returned by a test signup). Returns no body. Destructive - do not point it at the seeded customers 1 and 2.

item.name: Signup seller
item.description: Registers a new seller with the SellerDto body (businessName, contactNumber, city, address, username, email, password). businessName, contactNumber, username, email and password are required; city and address may be added later. Returns the created seller with its generated id.

item.name: Get all sellers
item.description: Returns every seller (seeded: 1 techstore, 2 fashionhub).

item.name: Get seller by id
item.description: Returns the seller with id 1 (techstore).

item.name: Delete seller by id
item.description: Deletes the seller row with the given id. Destructive - do not point it at the seeded sellers 1 and 2, which own the catalogue products.

item.name: Add user
item.description: Inserts a login user directly with the UserDto body (username, email, password, role). role is one of ROLE_CUSTOMER, ROLE_SELLER, ROLE_ADMIN. Returns no body; verify with GET /api/user/all.

item.name: Get all users
item.description: Returns every login user with its role.

item.name: Get user by id
item.description: Returns the login user with the given id.

item.name: Delete user by id
item.description: Deletes the login user with the given id. Destructive - deleting a seeded user would break login for that account.

item.name: Flow 2/6/8 - Category & Product
item.description: Category CRUD plus the seller-owned product catalogue: add, read, search, filter and stock management.

item.name: Add category
item.description: Creates a category with the CategoryDto body (name required, description and seq optional). Returns the created category with its generated id.

item.name: Get all categories
item.description: Returns all categories (seeded: 1 Electronics, 2 Mobile, 3 Fashion, 4 Home & Furniture).

item.name: Get category by id
item.description: Returns the category with id 1 (Electronics).

item.name: Update category
item.description: Replaces category 1 with the CategoryDto body and returns the updated category.

item.name: Delete category by id
item.description: Deletes the category with the given id. Destructive - do not point it at the seeded categories 1-4, which the seeded products reference.

item.name: Add product for seller 1
item.description: Adds a product owned by seller 1 (techstore) using the ProductDto body: name, price and stockQty are required (price must be positive, stockQty non-negative); brand, description, imageUrl and categoryId are optional. Returns the created product.

item.name: Get product by id
item.description: Returns product 1 (Sony WH-1000XM5, 24999, seller 1) with its category details.

item.name: Get product by id - ERROR invalid id
item.description: Error scenario: asks for a product that does not exist. Expected: 400 with message "Invalid product id".

item.name: Get all products
item.description: Returns the full catalogue (seeded: Sony WH-1000XM5, Dell XPS 15, iPhone 15 Pro, Cotton Shirt, Office Chair).

item.name: Get products by brand
item.description: Returns every product whose brand matches the brand query parameter exactly (case sensitive).

item.name: Get products by price range
item.description: Returns every product priced between the inclusive min and max query parameters.

item.name: Search products by name
item.description: Returns every product whose name contains the keyword (case insensitive partial match).

item.name: Get products by category
item.description: Returns every product in category 1 (Electronics).

item.name: Dynamic product filter
item.description: Applies any combination of the four optional query parameters brand, categoryId, minPrice and maxPrice in a single call; omitted parameters stay open and match everything. Try /api/product/filter?brand=Sony alone, or ?minPrice=1000&maxPrice=5000.

item.name: Mark product out of stock
item.description: Toggles the stock status of product 1 between IN_STOCK and OUT_OF_STOCK. Returns no body; confirm with GET /api/product/{id}.

item.name: Delete product by id
item.description: Deletes the product with the given id. Destructive - do not point it at the seeded products 1-5 unless the deletion itself is what you are testing.

item.name: Flow 3/4 - Address & Cart
item.description: Shipping addresses per customer and the shopping cart (add, view, update, remove).

item.name: Add shipping address for customer 1

body.raw:
{
  "recipientName": "John Doe",
  "phone": "9876543210",
  "streetAddress": "42 MG Road, Anna Nagar",
  "city": "Chennai",
  "state": "Tamil Nadu",
  "postalCode": "600028",
  "isDefault": true
}

item.description: Adds a ShippingAddressDto (recipientName, phone, streetAddress, city, state, postalCode all required, isDefault boolean) to customer 1 and returns it with the generated address id.

item.name: Get all addresses of customer 1
item.description: Returns every shipping address belonging to customer 1 (seeded: address 1).

item.name: Get address by id
item.description: Returns shipping address 1 (customer 1's default address, used by the seeded order).

item.name: Delete address by id
item.description: Deletes the address with the given id. Destructive - address 1 is the shipping address of the seeded order 1, so only delete addresses created for testing.

item.name: Add item to cart of customer 1
item.description: Adds product 1 (Sony WH-1000XM5) to customer 1's cart, creating the cart on first use. quantity defaults to 1. Returns the cart item with its cartItemId and line total.

item.name: View cart of customer 1
item.description: Returns customer 1's cart with all cart items and the grand total.

item.name: Update cart item quantity
item.description: Sets the quantity of cart item 1 to 2 and returns the updated cart item with the recalculated line total. Use a cartItemId returned by POST /api/cart/add.

item.name: Remove cart item
item.description: Removes cart item 1 from the cart. Destructive to the cart contents only; use a cartItemId returned by POST /api/cart/add.

item.name: Flow 4/5/7/8 - Order, Payment, Seller & Admin
item.description: Order placement and tracking, payment completion, seller order items and admin analytics.

item.name: Checkout customer 1 with address 1 (UPI)
item.description: Converts customer 1's cart into an order shipped to address 1. The method query parameter is a PaymentMethod: UPI, COD, CREDIT_CARD, DEBIT_CARD or NET_BANKING (defaults to COD). Returns the order with its order id, order number and items. Destructive: it empties the cart, consumes stock and creates a real order - only run it when placing an order is intended.

item.name: Get order by id
item.description: Returns seeded order 1 (order number Q1791738744814, UPI, COMPLETED) with its items, payment and shipping address.

item.name: Get orders of customer 1
item.description: Returns every order placed by customer 1.

item.name: Get tracking of order 1
item.description: Returns the order tracking timeline of order 1 ("Order placed successfully" first, one row appended as the order moves through PLACED, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED).

item.name: Get order items of seller 1
item.description: Returns every order item that belongs to seller 1's products, with its current status - the seller's view for fulfilment.

item.name: Update order item status
item.description: Sets the status of order item 1. status is an OrderStatus: PLACED, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED or CANCELLED; the usual timeline is PLACED - PROCESSING - SHIPPED - DELIVERED. Returns the updated order item.

item.name: Complete payment of order 1
item.description: Marks the payment of order 1 as COMPLETED and records the txnId. Payments start as PENDING at checkout. Returns the payment record with its transaction id and amount.

item.name: Admin - orders by status
item.description: Returns the count of order items grouped by OrderStatus.

item.name: Admin - user count
item.description: Returns the total number of login users.

item.name: Admin - seller count
item.description: Returns the total number of registered sellers.

variable.description: Base URL of the running QuitQ Spring Boot backend.
